name: Feishu Researcher Delegation Guard
description: Backstops researcher sessions_spawn calls from feishu-* agents by filling missing or legacy handoff/delivery metadata for Feishu export delivery.

defaultAllowedHandoff.description: Default Allowed handoff value for researcher sessions spawned from feishu-* agents.

defaultPreferredHandoff.description: Default Preferred handoff value for researcher sessions spawned from feishu-* agents.

exportPrefix.description: Base relative export directory used when Export location is missing or legacy.

exportBaseDir.description: Base relative export directory used when Export location is missing or legacy.

disableToken.description: Exact line-prefix token operators can place in the task to disable automatic Feishu handoff metadata patching.

defaultCompletionDelivery.description: Default sessions_spawn completionDelivery for researcher sessions spawned from feishu-* agents (default: parent).
